config.outputs: Require exact generated token IDs/raw answers for all matched control, stage, and trace examples
config.performance_boundary: Step 6 remains canonical. Same-run uninstrumented control repeats 10 warmups and 50 measurements per seed. Profile/trace timings are diagnostics, not speedup measurements.
config.stage_method: Synchronized diagnostic wall times; prefill is first forward minus nested get_image_features; decode is later cached forwards; residual is explicit
config.trace_method: PyTorch CPU+CUDA profiler; one profiler warmup and two active batches per seed; record_shapes/profile_memory true, with_stack false; traces keep native asynchronous stage execution, with only the original whole-batch synchronization
config.utilization_boundary: nvidia-smi samples cover warmups/measurements/file writes; trace GPU activity is union of kernel/copy intervals within annotated batches, not SM occupancy

benchmark.excluded: model loading, data/checkpoint hashing, W&B logging, JSON writing, profiler overhead, request queueing and batch formation wait
benchmark.latency_definition: all images in a batch complete together; elapsed/batch_size is amortized cost, not individual request latency
benchmark.memory: per-measurement PyTorch peak allocated and reserved bytes including resident model; reset peaks after warm-up; allocator cache retained between calls
benchmark.quality_failure: abort and investigate; do not silently select a different batch
benchmark.selection: smallest batch within 5% of best sweep throughput among successful candidates using <=80% of GPU memory
benchmark.timing_scope: warm-filesystem-cache end-to-end batch: read/decode/EXIF/RGB, processor, blocking H2D, greedy generation, D2H, text decoding and parsing; synchronize CUDA before start and before stop
benchmark.workload: 32 frozen validation images per class, seed-shuffled within class and interleaved; cyclic batches; measured stream restarts at index zero after warm-up; same seeded stream for every batch candidate

inference_config.prompt: Classify this brain MRI image into exactly one category: glioma, meningioma, notumor, pituitary. Use notumor for an image with no tumor. Reply with only the category name, without explanation.
